title: Pingdin — Platform Activity & Audit Trail (Managed tenants)

panels.title: core.audit_log — matching rows, newest first

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, trace_id, tenant_id, principal_id, action, resource_kind, resource_ref, outcome, subject_token, metadata FROM core.audit_log WHERE ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ('$tenant_id' = '' OR tenant_id::text = '$tenant_id') AND ('$subject_ref' = '' OR resource_ref ILIKE '%' || '$subject_ref' || '%' OR subject_token ILIKE '%' || '$subject_ref' || '%') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 500

panels.description: This is a read-only view of the same hash-chained, append-only table core_service/audit.py writes to on every mutating action. Filter by tenant_id or a resource_ref/subject_token fragment. Click a trace_id to jump to its full distributed trace once edge/core/compute are OTel-instrumented (pingdin_platform Phase C) — until then this column still lets you correlate rows that share one request.

panels.title: Matching container logs (all services, Loki)
panels.description: Container logs from edge, core and compute, filtered by the Subject box. Routine SUCCESSFUL lines are hidden by default — health checks and metrics scrapes that answered 200, and the scheduler's 15-second poll for due work — because they are roughly nine in ten lines and bury everything else. Failures (a 503 on /health, a 500 on a poll) and every other request still show. To see everything: Explore → Loki → {container="pingdin-edge"}.
